errors.quote: an exchange acts on chunks of only $K=\Theta(p^{\epsilon c})$ bits and saves a factor $K^{-(1-\tau)}=p^{-\epsilon c(1-\tau)}$ against a full pass
errors.problem: One exchange costs O(VK^tau) by the chunk-interchange lemma, which is more than one full pass O(V). The factor K^{-(1-tau)} is saved against a plain exchange by K scans (O(VK)), or equivalently against the plain layout at p per unit volume, not against a single full pass.

errors.quote: With $\lg n=\max\{\lceil\log_2n\rceil,1\}$, within a constant factor of $\log n$ and at least $1$
errors.problem: For n=1, log n=0 while lg n=1, so lg n is within a constant factor of log n only for n>=2. The max with 1 exists exactly to handle small n, as the paper's bound for every input length requires.
